central_unknown: Ferrari vs Mercedes vs Red Bull constructor pecking order at COTA — McLaren's relative weakness in ML projections creates a key budget allocation decision, and whether Verstappen's medium-risk DNF probability (14%) materializes could swing the entire weekend.

captains.label: Primary
captains.name: Max Verstappen
captains.reason: ML projects 28.9 exp pts (highest on grid), 39.2 proj pts, ppm 1.81, MEDIUM risk. Predicted to qualify P3 and finish P1 — significant overtake upside. FanAmp channels consistently rank Verstappen as the top captain option. 14% DNF probability is the main concern but upside justifies the pick. 90% CI [-11.5, 51.0].

captains.label: Differential
captains.name: Charles Leclerc
captains.reason: ML projects 28.1 exp pts (essentially tied with Antonelli), 30.8 proj pts, ppm 1.33, value 1.17 — best value among top-3 drivers. Predicted to qualify P1 and finish P2 with a 14% DNF risk. BoxBox previously noted Leclerc is 'on the trend up' and Ferrari looked strong in recent races. Lower ownership than Verstappen/Antonelli makes him a compelling differential captain.

buy.name: Gabriel Bortoleto
buy.note: ML projects 20.3 exp pts at only 7.0M — value score of 2.9 is the highest on the grid. LOW risk, 8% DNF. The ultimate budget enabler to afford premium drivers and constructors.

buy.name: Kimi Antonelli
buy.note: ML projects 28.4 exp pts, LOW risk (4% DNF), 90% CI [-3.7, 48.0]. Narrowest downside range among top drivers. FanAmp channels consistently back Antonelli as a core hold. Strong Mercedes pairing synergy.

buy.name: Charles Leclerc
buy.note: ML projects 28.1 exp pts, value 1.17 — cheapest of the Big 3 drivers with comparable expected points. Predicted P1 in qualifying. Ferrari constructor synergy makes him a natural pairing.

consider.name: Liam Lawson
consider.note: F1FantasyPolePosition flagged Lawson as a differential (<5% ownership in top 500). Recent scores of 17 pts in Malaysia. COTA may not be his strongest track but price is right. ML data not explicitly listed but Racing Bulls constructor shows 27.9 exp pts.

consider.name: Sergio Perez
consider.note: F1FantasyPolePosition calls him a 'transfer target/transfer trap' — floor price asset enabling mega-teams. Only 27% ownership in top 500. Volatile scoring (-18 to +13 recent range) but enables Verstappen + Red Bull constructor stacking at minimal cost.

consider.name: Lewis Hamilton
consider.note: ML projects 14.9 exp pts, LOW risk (10% DNF). Solid floor but significantly lower ceiling than Leclerc (16.3 proj vs 30.8 proj). Ferrari constructor pairing option if budget doesn't stretch to Leclerc elsewhere.

avoid: Lando Norris — ML projects only 13.5 exp pts despite 26.1M price, 18% DNF probability (highest among frontrunners), predicted to qualify P2 but drop to P5. McLaren constructor also ranks 4th.
George Russell — ML projects only 17.5 exp pts at 27.9M, poor value (0.63). No grid penalty boost this week unlike Singapore. Better to take Antonelli from Mercedes.
Fernando Alonso — F1FantasyPolePosition noted COTA is 'probably not an ideal option' for Aston Martin. Power-dependent circuit doesn't suit their package.

chips.name: Wildcard
chips.reason: No major structural team changes needed this week. The meta favors existing core assets (Verstappen, Antonelli, Leclerc). Save for a week with grid penalties, major price shifts, or constructor reshuffles.

chips.name: 3x Boost
chips.reason: If you have a strong lineup with Verstappen or Antonelli as captain, COTA could be a decent 3x weekend given the high expected points at the top. However, without a sprint to boost scoring ceiling, the multiplier effect is lower than sprint weekends.

chips.name: Limitless
chips.reason: BoxBox analysis from previous rounds showed 3x often outscores Limitless. Non-sprint weekend further reduces Limitless value. Save for a sprint weekend or major grid shakeup.

chips.name: Final Fix
chips.reason: Hold for a weekend where qualifying results create a clear pivot opportunity. No extraordinary circumstances flagged for COTA.

watch_items: Verstappen's 14% DNF probability — highest among the top 3 projected drivers. Monitor practice reliability closely before locking captain.
Mercedes constructor (61.9 exp pts, LOW risk) vs Ferrari constructor (56.4 exp pts but better value at 2.0 vs 1.82) — the 5.8M price gap could fund a driver upgrade.
McLaren underperformance — ML projects only 39.4 exp pts for the constructor (4th), with Norris at 18% DNF. This is a significant shift from recent form; monitor FP sessions.
Bortoleto's qualifying position — predicted P8 to P13 finish. If he qualifies higher, overtake points evaporate and his value case weakens.
Red Bull constructor (50.3 exp pts, MEDIUM risk) — wide confidence interval [5.6, 84.0] driven by Perez volatility. High ceiling if both drivers perform.
Perez price movement — at 3.0M floor price, even modest scoring triggers a price increase. F1FantasyPolePosition flagged this as a speculative asset play.
arc: The United States GP is a transitional race where the key strategic question is constructor allocation heading into the final stretch. Mercedes maintains the highest expected constructor points but at a premium price, while Ferrari offers better value. McLaren's projected dip at COTA (only 4th in constructor rankings) could signal a longer-term shift away from them. If Verstappen wins as projected, his price ceiling may lock out budget flexibility for Mexico and beyond. Bortoleto at 7.0M remains the critical budget enabler — his trajectory (value score 2.9) allows managers to run three premium assets. The next 1-2 races (Mexico, São Paulo) will test whether Ferrari's upward trend and McLaren's relative struggles are durable, so avoid burning chips now and preserve flexibility for what could be a more decisive points swing weekend.
